text_block_list.text:

If your trainee is weak... that's kinda awkward for a Trainer."

text_block_list.text:

It's not like I'm the only one having a rough time..."

choice_data_list: Will you keep working hard with me?
Will you keep working hard with me?

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

I chickened out earlier, but I'm totally fine now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I ain't gonna stop running!
No way I'm staying in the dumps like this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I dunno... but I just hate it.

text_block_list.text:
Losing totally bums me out...!
I hate it so, so much!!
choice_data_list: Is that feeling greater than the joy of victory?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"It's way crazier when you win...
Super crazy, honestly."
choice_data_list: Keeping that in mind, you should be able to get back up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Framing it like that is seriously so unfair...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, geez, I already know that kinda stuff...

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my nails first,
so let's do the review session after, 'kay~?
